company_name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd

canvas_categories.order_inflow_changes: Order backlog stands at an all-time high of ₹12,695 crore (+36% YoY) following the receipt of the Letter of Award (LoA) for a ₹215 crore 125 MW solar EPC Balance-of-System (BOS) contract in Rajasthan. Site execution mobilization and civil planning advance for the Rajasthan project while commercial banks expand non-fund guarantee lines by ₹500 crore to support active utility solar bidding.
canvas_categories.direct_company_news: (2026-11-18) Green Stocks Nov 18: Most Stocks Slip as Select Players Defy the Trend - Saur Energy [Saur Energy] | (2026-11-17) Supreme Court quashes ₹59.14 Cr GST demand against Sterling Wilson subsidiary - scanx.trade [scanx.trade] | (2026-11-16) 3 India Renewable Power Stocks Facing Rising Cost Pressure - Simply Wall St [Simply Wall St]
canvas_categories.promoter_activity: Reliance New Energy Limited (subsidiary of Reliance Industries Ltd) holds 40.0% strategic co-promoter ownership alongside Shapoorji Pallonji Group, providing balance sheet credibility, financial guarantees, and corporate backing.
canvas_categories.demand_cycle_changes: Accelerated multi-gigawatt renewable energy tenders in India (ISTS evacuation, CPSU solar schemes, FDRE projects) and international markets (GCC, Europe, Australia) drive unprecedented utility-scale solar EPC demand.
canvas_categories.raw_material_changes: Solar module prices remain structurally low globally, improving developer project internal rates of return (IRRs) and fast-tracking financial closures and EPC contract awards.
canvas_categories.institutional_activity: Institutional and infrastructure funds continued accumulating SWREL following the Supreme Court's clean legal verdict and expanding order book, maintaining healthy trading volume across exchanges.
canvas_categories.government_policy_changes: Operationalization of the PM-eBus Sewa Payment Security Mechanism (PSM ₹3,435 Cr) and the Supreme Court of India's landmark judgment upholding that retrospective 70:30 GST valuation is impermissible permanently protect renewable EPC contractors from legacy tax claims, removing an industry-wide legal cloud.
canvas_categories.sector_news: Utility-scale solar EPC contracting in India is entering an accelerated execution phase as transmission connectivity under ISTS Phase-II and Phase-III comes online.
canvas_categories.management_commentary: Management reiterated that eliminating legacy tax liabilities combined with an all-time record order book of ₹12,695 crore firmly cements SWREL's turnaround, positioning the company for sustained profitability and expanding EBITDA margins in H2 FY27 and FY28.
canvas_categories.competitor_news: Competes with Waaree RTL, Larsen & Toubro, and Tata Power Solar in utility-scale solar EPC; SWREL differentiates through its global execution footprint (>18 GW track record) and Reliance New Energy ecosystem synergies.
